verdict.rationale: Bento has event- and trigger-driven workflows with delays and branching (bento-docs-46), timed sequences (bento-docs-43), and API scheduling of one-time broadcasts (bento-docs-34). For recurring work, the evidence only suggests scripting a weekly job through the CLI or API (bento-docs-4, bento-docs-49), which implies an external scheduler. missing for 10: a native recurring or cron-style schedule trigger for workflows or jobs, documented recurring broadcasts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
